features: The player now uses a unified progress-driven morph for mini-player to full-player expansion and reverse collapse, with coordinated surface, scale, translation, and alpha motion.
Echo Motion now exposes a shared high-end motion contract for player morphs and app-identity title transitions without adding per-frame work.
The application public brand has been changed from Nivukx to Nivukx while preserving existing runtime integration contracts and feature implementations.
Complete Nivukx identity hardening: package/import namespaces, widgets, native JNI bindings, localized branding, deep links, and repository documentation.
bug_fixes: Audio quality selection now supports Auto, High, and Lossless when available while preserving legacy preference values.
Download quality selection now uses the same truthful quality tiers and no longer labels compressed YouTube audio as lossless.
Download stream resolution now honors the selected audio quality and isolates cached stream URLs by quality.
Welcome onboarding is now persisted as a first-launch experience instead of being shown again after every version change.
First-tap playback now uses Media3 play/pause commands so an idle player prepares and starts without requiring a second tap.
YouTube account handoff now opens YouTube Music directly so an existing authenticated web session can be reused without the generic Google ServiceLogin hop.
YouTube account handoff now verifies the returned session identity before completing login and keeps failed or mismatched sessions retryable.
CI now validates Universal GMS Kotlin compilation and Universal GMS APK builds without the removed FOSS fallback.
The stale FOSS product flavor and obsolete FOSS source-set shims were removed so app and playback modules match the documented GMS-only architecture.
Last.fm API credentials are no longer committed in Gradle and are now loaded from local.properties or environment variables.
The repository audit now verifies Universal GMS compilation, APK assembly, and lint instead of invoking removed FOSS build tasks.
Setup and README build instructions now consistently document the GMS-only build and local/CI secret handling.
The local.properties template now documents safe placeholders for optional development credentials without committing secrets.
Ringtone creation now respects the selected audio quality and performs a real FFmpeg trim instead of copying the source unchanged.
Audio export now respects the selected audio quality and reports streaming progress without blocking a coroutine with runBlocking.

CodeQL now traces the supported Universal GMS build instead of the removed/default assembleDebug path, preventing security-analysis runs from entering unintended variants and timing out before analysis.
The user-facing app display name now resolves to Nivukx through the canonical Android string resource.
